Backward compatibility verified against a real pre-existing delegation
record in this repo's own tree (TestLoadDelegation_BackwardCompat_
PreExistingRecordUnaffected).

Full security review and rejected alternatives in DESIGN.md DES-076
round 2.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

)"
